# Vendored code

| File | Package | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `qrcode.mjs` | qrcode-generator (`dist/qrcode.mjs`), by Kazuhiko Arase | 2.0.4 | MIT (header in the file) | https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator |

Copied unmodified from the npm package so the app needs no CDN at runtime. To update, replace the file with
the same path from a newer release and check the door QR code still scans.
